scope: per-user installer fix for installer/testpilot.iss: build, silent install, upgrade-over-install, silent uninstall, no administrative artifacts

why_admin_was_required: installer/testpilot.iss had no PrivilegesRequired, so Inno defaulted to admin
DefaultDirName={autopf} resolved to C:\Program Files for that mode
[Icons] used {group} and {autodesktop}, which in admin mode are ProgramData Start Menu and C:\Users\Public\Desktop
Inno writes the uninstall key to HKLM in admin mode

why_uninstaller_returned_1.observed: unins000.exe /VERYSILENT exited 1 and left an is-*.tmp directory in %TEMP%
why_uninstaller_returned_1.conclusion: an administrative install produces an uninstaller that requires the same elevation; the silent run could not initialize without it (Inno exit code 1 = setup failed to initialize)
why_uninstaller_returned_1.help_argument_hang: the uninstaller has no /? switch: it ignores unknown arguments and shows the modal confirmation dialog, which a -Wait host sees as a hang
why_uninstaller_returned_1.side_effect: HKLM key and shared shortcuts cannot be removed without elevation, so residue stays
